prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 16:10 landscape, first viewport plus a visible beginning of the second section
Primary request: Design a bold, production-grade homepage comp for the Brazilian ecommerce brand "Medicina Sagrada" using the visual world "Cartaz da Floresta", translated from rigorous four-ink silkscreen travel posters into a contemporary ecommerce interface. This is a persuasive website, not a standalone poster or moodboard.
Structure: a compact horizontal header with the Medicina Sagrada brand name, navigation "Rapé", "Sananga", "Artesanato", "Etnias", "Nossa história", search and cart; a full-width hero composed in strong flat silkscreen planes with one decisive documentary Amazon landscape plate, a large product still-life in the foreground, a blocky title panel, and an unmistakable orange catalog CTA. Reveal the beginning of section two with seven circular photography portals labeled "Huni Kuin", "Shawãdawa", "Kuntanawa", "Nukini", "Yawanawa", "Apurinã", "Shanenawa", plus a slim right shortcut "VER TODAS AS ETNIAS →".
Exact hero text: "Medicinas indígenas originais, direto da floresta."
Exact supporting text: "Conheça produtos de diferentes povos e histórias de origem."
Exact CTA: "ENTRAR NO CATÁLOGO"
Visual system: disciplined screenprinted cultural poster translated into navigation, controls and sections; bold geometric planes, visible paper stock, hard ink edges, contemporary Brazilian graphic design.
Palette: four committed inks #17401D deep green, #248C34 bright green, #EF492B orange, #A3250F deep red, with #F4F0E6 paper showing through.
Typography: blocky geometric caps mixed with a friendly sturdy sans; no high-contrast serif and no generic wellness typography.
Composition: one dominant scene with clear ecommerce hierarchy, product and CTA readable in five seconds, dramatic flat-color fields, no generic centered hero and no card grid inside the hero.
Image ethics: do not invent Indigenous portraits, body paint, clothing, symbols, or tribal patterns. Use landscape, tools, plant material and craft-detail placeholders only. The seven circles will later receive real authorized photography.
Constraints: no fabricated reviews, prices, certifications, badges, health claims, discounts, or impact numbers. No tourist postcard clichés, mystical smoke, mandalas, generic leaf logos, gold luxury styling, beige wellness template, glassmorphism, gradients, watermarks, browser chrome, or device frame. Render as a polished website screen with crisp UI text.
